==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Near the entrance of the [[Ancient Guthixian Temple]].
|startmap = 4052,4562,plane:0
|difficulty = Grandmaster
|description = The Mahjarrat Lucien's meddling with the Stone of Jas has opened an ancient entrance to a cache of Guthix's most prized possessions: the Fractured Archive.

Whispers of the archive have persisted through the ages, and the gods have taken notice of this accidental grand opening. Some have sent agents to plunder the archive and bolster their strength, while other interested parties have their own motivations for making this daring descent.

If even a single one of these artefacts were to fall into the wrong hands, it could spell Gielinor's ruin, so it falls to you to defend the archive from those who would misuse it.
|length = Medium
